app.activate.where: Full-screen blocking prompt when the display opens or reloads, above every other screen
app.activate.meaning: Tap once so the display can sound allergy alarms. It stays up until sound actually works.
app.activate.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. "alarmas de alergias" = alarms for allergies; must not read as "allergy-free".
app.activate.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. 过敏警报 = allergy alarm.

hdr.kitchen.meaning: "<Venue> · Kitchen" — which venue this screen belongs to.

lang.blocked.meaning: Language did not change because a hold or a save is in progress. Finish that first.

lang.not_saved.meaning: Language changed on this screen but was not saved to the display; it will retry.

status.paired.meaning: "<Display name> · Paired" — this screen is signed in to the venue.

status.not_paired.meaning: This screen is not signed in to any venue and shows no allergies.

offline.banner.meaning: The screen has lost its connection and new allergy alerts are NOT arriving.

board.empty.where: Board when there is nothing to show
board.empty.meaning: No open allergy records for this service.

board.needs.meaning: Records the kitchen has not yet confirmed receiving — act now.
board.needs.concern: Deliberately not literal ("Te necesita"); "Requiere acción" chosen for clarity.

board.working.meaning: Records received and in the kitchen workflow.

board.done.meaning: Records marked served in this service.
board.done.zh_concern: "service" = "餐段" (meal period). "本班次" (this shift) is an alternative; confirm which the kitchen uses.

summary.tables.one.meaning: Count of tables with open records — singular.

summary.tables.other.meaning: Count of tables with open records — plural.

summary.anaphylaxis.meaning: How many open records are anaphylaxis severity.
summary.anaphylaxis.concern: "{n} con anafilaxia" = n records with anaphylaxis severity. Confirm it reads as a count of records, not of people with a diagnosis.
summary.anaphylaxis.zh_concern: Counts records with anaphylaxis severity. See sev.anaphylaxis.

summary.need_action.one.meaning: One record not yet confirmed by the kitchen.

summary.need_action.other.meaning: Several records not yet confirmed by the kitchen.

summary.all_confirmed.meaning: Every open record has been confirmed received.
summary.all_confirmed.concern: "All Confirmed" means all RECEIVED — not that anything is safe. "Todas confirmadas" agrees with "alergias".

row.rehearsal.meaning: This record is from a practice run, not a real guest.

row.updated.meaning: The guest changed this allergy record; this is the newer version.

row.confirm_received.meaning: Hold to confirm the kitchen has received this allergy.

row.confirm_prep.meaning: Hold to confirm the prep area has been cleared and separated.

row.second_check.meaning: Open the Second Check for this record.

row.mark_served.meaning: Hold to record that this dish has left the kitchen.

sev.anaphylaxis.meaning: The guest stated anaphylaxis: the most severe reaction.
sev.anaphylaxis.concern: Medical term "ANAFILAXIA". Confirm kitchen staff recognise it; if not, pair it with a plain word without weakening it.
sev.anaphylaxis.zh_concern: "过敏性休克" (literally "allergic shock") is the common term for anaphylaxis; "严重过敏反应" is an alternative. Confirm staff read it as the most severe reaction even before shock occurs.

sev.severe.meaning: The guest stated a severe reaction.
sev.severe.zh_concern: "严重" — confirm it is clearly below anaphylaxis and above discomfort.

sev.discomfort.meaning: The guest stated discomfort: the mildest stated severity.
sev.discomfort.concern: "MALESTAR" — confirm it reads as neither more nor less serious than "discomfort".
sev.discomfort.zh_concern: "不适" for the mildest stated severity. Confirm it reads as neither more nor less serious than "discomfort".

sev.unsure.meaning: The guest did not say how severe the reaction is. Treat the allergy as real.
sev.unsure.concern: NOT "NO SEGURO": "seguro" also means "safe", so "no seguro" reads as "not safe". "GRAVEDAD NO INDICADA" = severity not stated. Confirm.
sev.unsure.zh_concern: "严重程度未说明" = the guest did not state how severe. Must not read as "not serious".

sev.unknown.meaning: The record has no severity value.

chip.cross_contact.meaning: The guest asked for CROSS-CONTACT precautions: prevent any trace of the allergen reaching their food through shared surfaces, utensils, oil, gloves or hands — not only bacterial contamination.
chip.cross_contact.concern: "CONTACTO CRUZADO" (allergen-specific) vs "contaminación cruzada" (common kitchen term that usually means microbial cross-contamination, a different concept). Do not choose "contaminación cruzada" just because it is familiar; the allergen meaning must survive.
chip.cross_contact.zh_concern: "交叉接触" (allergen cross-contact) vs "交叉污染" (cross-contamination, which kitchen staff usually understand as germs / hygiene — a different concept). The allergen meaning must survive; do not choose "交叉污染" just because it is familiar.

reh.full.where: Top of the record and the lockout
reh.full.meaning: This whole record is a practice run. There is no real guest at this table.
reh.full.concern: Guest word. For Mexican / U.S. kitchens "cliente" or "comensal" is likely more natural than "huésped" (hotel register). Choose one word and use it in reh.full, notes.heading and misc.guest.
reh.full.zh_concern: "演练" (drill / exercise) vs "测试" (test) vs "彩排" (rehearsal). It must be unmistakable that there is no real guest.

step.ack.meaning: Current step: the kitchen confirms it has received the allergy.
step.ack.zh_concern: "确认已收到" = confirm (the kitchen) received it. Must not read as "allergy confirmed / verified".

step.prep.meaning: Current step: confirm the prep area, utensils and surfaces are cleared and separated.
step.prep.concern: "Confirmación de preparación" can read as "the dish was prepared". The step is confirming the PREP AREA was cleared. (The English has the same ambiguity.)
step.prep.zh_concern: "备餐区确认" can read as confirming the dish was prepared; the step is confirming the prep AREA is cleared and separated.

step.verify.meaning: Current step: another team member checks the allergy preparation before the dish leaves.
step.verify.concern: "Segunda revisión", deliberately NOT "verificación": "verificado" reads as "verified safe", a stronger claim than "Second Check".
step.verify.zh_concern: "二次检查" chosen. "复核" is also natural but can read as a formal sign-off; "验证/核验" (verify) are NOT acceptable — they imply verified safe.

step.serve.meaning: Current step: record that the dish has left the kitchen.
step.serve.concern: Agreement: "servida" agrees with "la alergia" (the record). If it reads as the dish it should be "servido" (el plato). Decide once — it recurs in row.mark_served, hold.serve, rail.served, err.serve, title.served_done.
step.serve.zh_concern: "标记已出餐" = mark as left the kitchen. Must not imply the guest received or ate it.

step.waiting.meaning: How long the current step has been waiting.
step.waiting.zh_concern: The timer keeps its Latin units ("5d 23h"). Decide whether Chinese staff need "天 / 小时" — that is a display-format change, not a string.

hold.ack.where: Main hold button — record and lockout
hold.ack.meaning: Press and hold to record that the kitchen received this allergy.
hold.ack.concern: "Mantén presionado" is the Mexican / Latin-American form (not Spain's "pulsado"). Informal "tú" is used throughout — confirm that register suits U.S. kitchen crews.
hold.ack.zh_concern: "长按" = press and hold. See step.ack.

hold.prep.where: Main hold button — record and lockout
hold.prep.meaning: Press and hold to record that the prep area was cleared and separated.
hold.prep.concern: "despejada" = cleared of things. Must NOT drift toward "limpia/libre de alérgenos" (a claim). Confirm a cook reads it as "cleared and separated".
hold.prep.zh_concern: "清理" can read as "cleaned" (stronger — implies allergen residue removed) rather than "cleared and separated". Alternatives: "腾空" (emptied), "整理". Must not drift toward "无过敏原" (allergen-free).

hold.verify.meaning: Press and hold to record that the Second Check happened.

hold.serve.meaning: Press and hold to record that the dish left the kitchen.

do.ack.meaning: Confirm the kitchen has received this allergy.

do.prep.meaning: Clear and separate the prep area, utensils and surfaces.

do.verify.meaning: Have a different team member check the allergy preparation. (The display cannot prove who did.)

do.serve.meaning: Record served when the dish leaves the kitchen.

do.complete.meaning: All four Kitchen steps are recorded. It says nothing about the guest or the plate.
do.complete.zh_concern: "已全部记录" (all recorded) chosen over "已完成" so it claims only that the steps were recorded.

do.gone.meaning: This record is no longer current work here; nothing was recorded on this screen.

title.record.meaning: An allergy record with no current step.

title.second_check_done.zh_concern: "已记录二次检查" = a second check was recorded. Must not imply the food was found safe.

title.served_done.concern: Awkward ("Servida: registrado"). Needs a native phrasing that says only "served was recorded", and must not imply the guest received or ate it.
title.served_done.zh_concern: "已记录出餐" = served was recorded. Must not imply the guest received or ate it.

title.gone.meaning: This record is no longer on the board.

ok.prep.meaning: The "prep area cleared" step was recorded.

rail.received.meaning: Stage 1 — the allergy reached the kitchen.

ref.avoid_all.meaning: "Avoid all — <allergen>": ingredients that contain or derive from this allergen.
ref.avoid_all.concern: Infinitive "Evitar todo" (sign style) vs imperative "Evita todo". The allergen name after the dash is English data until a canonical allergen vocabulary exists, so the heading is mixed-language by design.
ref.avoid_all.zh_concern: "全部避开 — {allergen}" vs "禁用" (prohibited) / "避免使用". The allergen after the dash stays English data, so the heading is mixed-language by design.

ref.check_ingredients.where: Heading when no reference list exists
ref.check_ingredients.meaning: There is no list for this allergen; check the ingredients yourself.
ref.check_ingredients.zh_concern: "核对配料" = check the ingredients against the order. Must not become "核验" (verify).

ref.no_list.meaning: No reference list exists; confirm ingredients before preparing.

ref.untranslated.meaning: Tells the cook the allergen names and lists are in English and were NOT translated.
ref.untranslated.concern: Must state plainly that this data is untranslated. It is shown only when the screen language is not English.

notes.heading.concern: See reh.full ("huésped" vs "cliente"/"comensal"). "(sin traducir)" is deliberate: guest text is never machine-translated.
notes.heading.zh_concern: "顾客" vs "客人" / "食客". "（未翻译）" is deliberate: guest text is never machine-translated.

prov.line.meaning: "<Display> · <Venue> — records the display, not the person." The screen knows which display acted, never which person.
prov.line.zh_concern: "记录的是显示屏，不是人员" — confirm it reads as "the display, not a person, is recorded" without implying anything about who acted.

prov.this_display.meaning: "This display" when the display name is not known yet.

prov.this_venue.meaning: "this venue" before the venue name loads.
prov.this_venue.concern: "este local" reads Spain-leaning; "este restaurante" is likely more natural in Mexican / U.S. kitchens.

lock.next.meaning: The next Kitchen step for this record is the Second Check.

misc.table.meaning: "Table" when a record has no service point.

err.not_paired.meaning: Nothing was recorded: this screen is not paired. Pair it in Set Up (Admin).
err.not_paired.concern: "Set Up" kept in English: it is the Admin menu label.
err.not_paired.zh_concern: "Set Up" kept in English: it is the Admin menu label.

err.verify.meaning: "Second Check" was NOT recorded. Hold again.

err.minimize.meaning: Hidden on this screen but not saved.

pair.body.meaning: Where to get the 6-digit code in Admin.

pair.done_body.meaning: This display is signed in to the venue; it identifies the display, not the person.
pair.done_body.zh_concern: Deliberately avoids "认证" (which also means "certified"); uses "绑定" (linked) to the venue.

board.carried.where: Board section heading, directly below Needs You
board.carried.meaning: Records still open from an earlier service. They still need the kitchen steps.
board.carried.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
board.carried.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. 餐段 is used for "service" throughout.

board.carried_note.where: Under the From Earlier Service heading
board.carried_note.meaning: These records are still open; closing the earlier service did not complete them.
board.carried_note.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must not imply the records are finished or archived.
board.carried_note.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must not imply the records are finished or archived.

lock.queue.where: Anaphylaxis lockout, under the rehearsal marker
lock.queue.meaning: This is one of N anaphylaxis alerts waiting; the next opens after this one is handled.
lock.queue.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
lock.queue.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. 第 1 条，共 {n} 条 = item 1 of n.

row.not_saved.where: Strip under a board row after a write failed or got no response
row.not_saved.meaning: The last step was NOT saved. Tap to open the record and hold again.
row.not_saved.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
row.not_saved.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.

err.timeout.where: Record sheet / lockout, after a hold that got no response
err.timeout.meaning: No response from Happy Chair, so the step is not saved here. Hold again.
err.timeout.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
err.timeout.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.

note.already_recorded.where: Record sheet / lockout, after a hold whose step the database already had
note.already_recorded.meaning: The step was already recorded (on another display, or by an earlier attempt). This hold changed nothing.
note.already_recorded.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must not read as "saved now".
note.already_recorded.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must not read as "saved now".

card.also_here.one.meaning: Another open allergy record exists for the same table and guest visit.
card.also_here.one.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must state a count only — never that one record corrects or replaces the other.
card.also_here.one.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must state a count only — never that one record corrects or replaces the other.

card.also_here.other.meaning: Other open allergy records exist for the same table and guest visit.
card.also_here.other.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Same as the singular.
card.also_here.other.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Same as the singular.

row.unconfirmed.meaning: This display could not confirm whether the last step was saved. Tap to open the record.
row.unconfirmed.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
row.unconfirmed.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.

err.unconfirmed.meaning: The board could not confirm the step after a write. The state is unknown — check the record.
err.unconfirmed.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must not read as "not saved" or "saved".
err.unconfirmed.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker. Must not read as "not saved" or "saved".

note.changed_while_saving.meaning: The record changed while this step was being saved; the screen shows what the database has.
note.changed_while_saving.concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
note.changed_while_saving.zh_concern: Machine draft (W1-3, Oct 8 2026) — not reviewed by a native speaker.
